mapper.select: SELECT a.`ITEM_器件编码` AS code, a.`ITEM_器件小类编码` AS xiaoLeiCode, a.`ITEM_器件小类名称` AS xiaoleiName, a.`ITEM_物料描述` AS itemDesc, a.`ITEM_单位名称` AS categoryName, CASE a.`ITEM_编码状态` WHEN '临时' THEN '02' WHEN '正式' THEN '04' ELSE '01' END AS itemStatus, CASE a.`ITEM_器件等级` WHEN '消费级' THEN '01' WHEN '工业级' THEN '02' WHEN '汽车级' THEN '03' WHEN '军工级' THEN '04' ELSE '05' END AS itemLevel, CASE a.`ITEM_ROHS标识` WHEN 'R5' THEN '01' ELSE '02' END AS rohs, CASE a.`ITEM_REACH标识` WHEN '符合' THEN '01' WHEN '不符合' THEN '02' ELSE null END AS reach FROM rdm.`tlk_研发器件库` a WHERE a.`ITEM_器件编码` = #{code}
